title: icculus config document
description: The declarative config shape consumed by `icculus init --config <file>` and by an adapter's `adapter.json`. Its slots/scopes/side_gates/ratchets are written into a project's .icculus/config.toml via the comment-preserving editor. Every field is optional.

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by icculus.

version.description: Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 1.

slug.description: Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

source_globs.description: Primary source globs (the gated `web` scope), e.g. ["src/**"].

brief.description: Free-text description of what the project is.

agents.description: Which agent instruction files to compile from .icculus/guidelines/.

description.description: Adapter metadata, shown when listing adapters; ignored by `init --config`.

slots.description: [slots.<name>] fills. Omit `phase` for a measurement slot (the gate never runs it; a ratchet does).

phase.description: Gate phase. Omit for a measurement slot.

side_gates.description: [scopes.side_gates].<scope> commands, run when that scope changed.

ratchets.description: [ratchets.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.

metric.description: Metric name the slot emits (default: the ratchet name).

direction.description: "up": limit is a floor; "down": limit is a ceiling. Default "up".

slot.description: The [slots.<name>] (a measurement slot) whose output emits the metric.
